It requires no deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just visual recognition and navigation. The task is easily verifiable (the agent needs to be near and looking at the banner) and can be set up in an interesting scene with some navigation complexity. milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the magenta wall banner (placed at spawn-relative [8, 2, 6] on the north-facing wall of the stone brick building) and be looking approximately toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the banner, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than facing away.

scene_description: A small area with two structures: a stone brick building with a magenta wall banner on its north-facing entrance wall, and a wooden (oak plank) building further away. A cobblestone wall with lantern and oak fences add navigational landmarks. The player must explore and locate the magenta wall banner on the stone brick building.
task_text: Find the magenta wall banner. Look around the area and locate a magenta wall banner attached to a building wall.
design_notes: The magenta wall banner is placed at ~8 ~2 ~6 facing north on the front wall of the stone brick building. The building entrance is at ~7 ~1-2 ~6. The player spawns at ~0 ~1 ~0 and needs to walk approximately 8-10 blocks to reach the banner. The banner is visible from the approach direction. The oak plank building at ~-3 to ~-6, ~-4 to ~-7 serves as a distractor. Cobblestone wall with lantern at ~-8 to ~-6, ~2 adds visual interest.
